"""TSV cell sanitizer."""
from typing import Optional

def sanitize_cell(text: Optional[str]) -> str:
    if text is None:
        return ""
    # Escape double quotes by replacing them with two double quotes
    text = text.replace('"', '""')
    # Escape tab characters by replacing them with their escaped form
    text = text.replace('\t', '\\t')
    # Escape newline characters by replacing them with their escaped form
    text = text.replace('\n', '\\n')
    return text

def requires_sanitization(text: str) -> bool:
    return any(c in text for c in ('\t', '\n', '"'))
